findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 5 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 25 questions numbered 1-25; by section: 5.1 1, 5.2 6, 5.3 1, 5.4.1 2, 5.4.2 1, 5.4.3 1, 5.4.4 1, 5.5 1, 5.6 1, 5.7 1, 5.8 1, 5.9 2, 5.10 2, 5.11 1, 5.12 2, 5.13 1.

Theory questions cover properties of gases, the ideal gas equation and the Mᵣ relation, properties of liquids, London forces (size and shape), dipole-dipole forces, hydrogen bonding and its effects on water, surface tension, viscosity, evaporation, vapour pressure, boiling point and its factors, molar heats of fusion and vaporization, properties of solids, crystal growth and habit, amorphous solids and liquid crystals; five numericals (PV = nRT, Mᵣ = mRT/PV, q = nΔH) use new values recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed: ΔHf of ice 6.01 kJ mol⁻¹; 41 kJ mol⁻¹; C₂₀H₄₂ icosane. Exercise descriptive questions Q3-Q7 are not repeated.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
